done_when: A docs-only change with a clean light review passes forge-pr-check when its event base is older than the default branch it merged, while a sign-off merged to the default branch after the review still makes a light prototype review stale

findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Not done
Case: normal use - A README-only fix receives a light prototype review, then the client signs off on the default branch. The docs-only return at this line keeps the review at P0 without checking sign-off, even though review.run uses the restricted prototype prompt for such a fix (src/forge/review.py:862). The old review therefore remains current. The named sign-off proof uses the default app.py change (tests/test_aha_review.py:41 and tests/test_close.py:228), so it misses this case. A code fix also remains current if sign-off is on origin/main but absent from both the older event base and the PR head: the prototype check reads only those two refs (src/forge/review.py:172 and 187). This is additional evidence beyond the ruling about which base to use for the diff.

findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Not done
Case: normal use - A docs-only fix has a clean review and then merges a newer default-branch code commit whose message contains a Functional check paragraph, as user-facing work does. The changed level check uses diff_base, but fingerprint still reads that paragraph from the older event base (src/forge/review.py:163). The history walk includes the merged default-branch commit (src/forge/repo.py:446), so its unrelated paragraph changes the digest and forge-pr-check still calls the review out of date. The new test's incoming commit has no Functional check paragraph (tests/test_prcheck_light_review_older_base.py:14), so it does not catch this case.

stop.reason: The owner chose one more round

why: forge-pr-check can still call a clean light review out of date for a docs-only change that merged a newer default-branch commit with code changes, when the check's event base is older: prcheck passes the older event base to blocking_level (src/forge/review.py about 172, src/forge/docskip.py about 113), so the unrelated default-branch code counts in the docs-only classification and the light review looks no longer allowed. Part of client issue #1594, left by the owner's accept on 16 Nov 2026.
